study: studies/identifiability/lag-forgetting-v2 (lag_forgetting_v2.py) -- re-registration of lag-forgetting's Wald split with a floor matched to each corpus
note: RE-REGISTRATION AFTER SEEING ESTIMATES (v1's real numbers had been read; the re-run reproduces them exactly, max |diff| 0.0). Estimand, verdicts and programme rule imported unchanged from lag-forgetting; only the gate is new. Design 94ece18; calibration of the case generator against v1's agent floor, with a units fix and A's parent gate (CHANGES, c8a9901; EDGE still departs by -0.022 on the EARLY A gap, in the conservative direction). MATCHED FLOOR, sized cell by cell to each corpus's outcome-free Wald counts, 40 seeds per world; pass requires >= 32/40 detection, <= 2/40 wrong-world calls, <= 4/40 NULL false calls. ASSISTments (62 pairs) FAILS on power (FORGET 2/40, EDGE 5/40, no wrong-world calls); EdNet (650) PASSES (40, 36, 0, 0); Eedi (2,700) PASSES (40, 40, 0, 0). XES3G5M UNANSWERABLE on positivity (17 held pairs). REAL (B-item bootstrap, 2,000 draws): Eedi MOSTLY-FORGETTING, share explained +1.05 [+0.81, +1.43], D_sub -0.038 [-0.047, -0.029], D_held +0.002 [-0.008, +0.013], E flat 0.686 -> 0.694. The A gap closes because non-masters' current A accuracy rises (+0.064 [+0.056, +0.071]) while masters' does not fall (+0.006 [-0.000, +0.012]), so this is not past masters forgetting. EdNet NO-DECAY-TO-SPLIT (D_sub -0.005 [-0.025, +0.014]). ASSISTments UNANSWERABLE. Programme verdict UNRESOLVED (one corpus). F1 keeps 'the drop shrinks with lag'; on Eedi the edge does not weaken, and the decay tracks non-masters catching up on A. Moves nothing.
